Subject: Your consumer complaint matter

Dear Mr. Chandran,

Thank you for meeting us on 3 July 2026 about your dispute with Qureshi Developers. As we understand it, the flat was handed over with serious construction defects.

Our advice is to commission a structural audit report on the defects before the first hearing. Please collect photographs of the defects and a structural audit report and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs. 9,02,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
